matter.MatterTitle: An ordinance approving Amendment 2 to contract number 459172 between the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, through the Department of Water and Sewerage Services, and CDM Smith.

text:
..title
An ordinance approving Amendment 2 to contract number 459172 between the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, through the Department of Water and Sewerage Services, and CDM Smith.
..body
WHEREAS, the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, through the Department of Water and Sewerage Services, entered into a contract with CDM Smith for design solutions and services, drawings, construction documents, cost estimating, scheduling services, and construction phase services for reservoir improvements at various Metro sites; and 
WHEREAS, Ordinance No. BL2024-355 approved Amendment 1 to contract number 459172, which extended the term of the contract until project completion; and 
WHEREAS, Amendment 2 to the contract increases the contract value by $400,000, from $1,200,000 to $1,600,000, replaces Exhibit A – Pricing,  removes the requirement to identify the project name, RFQ or Contract number on the ACORD document, and adds new terms related to Outstanding Purchase Orders, Survival, Tennessee Procurement Protection Act, and Conflicting Vendor Terms; and 
WHEREAS, it is in the best interest of the Metropolitan Government that this amendment be approved. 
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT ENACTED BY THE COUNCIL OF THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY:
Section 1. That Amendment No. 2 to the Contract between the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County and CDM Smith (contract number 459172), a copy of which is attached hereto and incorporated herein, is hereby approved, and the Metropolitan Mayor is authorized to execute the same.
Section 2. Amendments to this legislation shall be approved by resolution.
Section 3. That this Ordinance shall take effect from and after its final passage, the welfare of the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County requiring it.
..Agenda Analysis
Analysis

This ordinance authorizes the second amendment to a contract between the Metropolitan Department of Water and Sewerage Services and CDM Smith.

The contract was originally awarded through competitive bid for design services, drawings, construction documents, cost estimates, scheduling services, and construction phase services for reservoir improvements at various Metro sites.

The original contract began on November 12, 2019. The first amendment to this contract, as approved through Ordinance No. BL2024-355, extended the contract term to end at project completion. Section 4.12.060(A) of the Metropolitan Code limits the term of contracts for services to sixty (60) months, unless otherwise approved by the Metropolitan Council.

The proposed amendment increases the contract value by $400,000, from $1,200,000 to $1,600,000, replaces the contract’s pricing exhibit, removes the requirement to identify the project name, RFQ or contract number on a certificate of insurance, and adds new language related to outstanding purchase orders, compliance with state law, and other standard contract terms.

Future amendments to this legislation may be approved by resolution.

Fiscal Note: This amendment increases the contract value of contract number 459172 with CDM Smith, Inc. for design services for Phase II Reservoirs by $400,000, from $1,200,000 to $1,600,000 to be paid from Fund 47410, Business Unit 65490132.
